implemented_or_usable_patterns.name: configs

implemented_or_usable_patterns.name: preprocess.fetch
implemented_or_usable_patterns.notes: Fetch layer returns bytes/metadata; can use network for arXiv/HTTP, local file reads for local input.

implemented_or_usable_patterns.name: preprocess.format
implemented_or_usable_patterns.notes: PDF uses PyMuPDF plain text, HTML uses trafilatura; high-fidelity PDF/markdown engines are future/optional.

implemented_or_usable_patterns.name: paper_flow
implemented_or_usable_patterns.notes: Fetches/formats input and calls OpenAI Agents SDK Agent(output_type=Paper).

implemented_or_usable_patterns.name: batch_run
implemented_or_usable_patterns.notes: Bounded concurrency over flow inputs; memory= is intentionally forbidden in MVP.

implemented_or_usable_patterns.name: magic resolver
implemented_or_usable_patterns.notes: Introspects flow signature and calls OpenAI Agents SDK to resolve typed input/cfg.

implemented_or_usable_patterns.name: BaseKnowledge provenance
implemented_or_usable_patterns.notes: SourceRef, ExtractionRef, Citation, as_of, confidence, tags, content_hash.

implemented_or_usable_patterns.name: TreeKnowledge
implemented_or_usable_patterns.notes: Hierarchical node graph with root, children, citations, summary/content; PageIndex-style navigation pattern.

implemented_or_usable_patterns.name: Paper and PaperKnowledgeCard
implemented_or_usable_patterns.notes: Paper is TreeKnowledge; PaperKnowledgeCard is FlattenKnowledge summary card linked by paper_id.
